author: bardic-inspiration
name: Rivet-Proof Half Plate
summary: Half plate that shrugs off the crushing of heavy weapons.
description: Dwarven armorers rivet every plate twice and call the second row a courtesy. It is noisy and proud of it.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. You have Resistance to Bludgeoning damage from nonmagical attacks.
